confirmed_findings.finding: Causal Q + I2 strongly improves pinned Qwen policy on hostile unseen benchmark
Causal Q + I2 strongly outperforms global-prior baseline
Full VP executive (Q+I2+Progress) beats both C0 and B0 with all 7 pre-registered gates
confirmed_findings.evidence: VP vs C0: +24.68 utility, 27 rescues/0 breaks. VP vs B0: +27.35 utility, 29 rescues/0 breaks. All 7 gates pass.

confirmed_findings.finding: Progress tie-breaking rescues V1 failures on hard chain tasks without breaking any successes
confirmed_findings.evidence: 2 rescues/0 breaks on chain tasks. Mechanism: removes redundant RETRIEVE to preserve budget. Delta_U(VP-V1)=+1.14, CI includes 0. McNemar p=0.50.

confirmed_findings.finding: I2 categorical interface prevents numerical pseudo-precision from corrupting LLM policy
confirmed_findings.evidence: Frozen before confirmation, never modified. Passes near-optimal set rather than scalar values.

rejected_hypotheses.note: QCAUSAL_V2 not justified by current evidence, not permanently impossible.

rejected_hypotheses.evidence: Only 3/11 category/action pairs showed meaningful temporal effects (27.3%, below 30% threshold). I2 already prevents live-policy failure from repeated retrieval.
